adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly introduces a new `cook_method` that returns `raw` when set to `Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb), bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb), and `TopicEmbed.import_remote` sources `doc.content` from `Readability::Document` while allowing `a`/`img` with `href`/`src` attributes, with no additional sanitization. The embed view then renders this HTML via `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). Nothing in the diff strips dangerous attributes/schemes (e.g., `javascript:`), so arbitrary stored HTML from the embeddable host/feed can be rendered on the Discourse origin, enabling stored XSS.
